introHtml: Tritan is a BPA-free copolyester that combines the clarity of glass with the durability of plastic, making it an ideal material for custom wine tumblers. Unlike standard stainless steel or acrylic options, Tritan tumblers are lightweight, shatter-resistant, and won't retain flavors or odors. Perfect for outdoor events, corporate picnics, or trade shows where glass is prohibited, these tumblers can be decorated with full-color logos using screen printing or digital transfer. The 12 oz Urban Peak 3-in-1 Trail Tumbler exemplifies the versatility of Tritan with its leak-resistant lid and integrated carry loop.
heroAltText: Custom Tritan wine tumblers with full-color logo decoration, lightweight and shatter-resistant for outdoor events
